subject: english
stem: Mia reaches Harbor Day at 10:50 without a workshop booking. Can she still make a booking?
options: Yes, because the Museum time was 10:40.
Yes, because three workshop markers exist.
No, because the Market is full.

optionRationales.reason: No, booking closed at 10:20.：實際抵達 10:50 晚於附註截止 10:20。
Yes, because the Museum time was 10:40.：忽略延誤與截止。
Yes, because three workshop markers exist.：數量不取消預約截止。
No, because the Market is full.：Market 狀態與 workshop booking 無關。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「主表或圖表提供的數值與 NOTE 限制同時套用後只剩一個可行方案」可推出 No, booking closed at 10:20.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 No, booking closed at 10:20. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
